Scholarships

Scholarships are available for qualifying families. Please note: You must complete the scholarship application, submit it with proof of income and assistance, and be approved BEFORE registering your child. Player placement is on a first come, first served basis. Please submit your completed scholarship application early, as the approval process can take up to two weeks. Families with more than one child participating may qualify for a discount for each additional child. For any questions, call 218-576-6174.

Scholarships are made available in part by The Brady VanHove Memorial Scholarship and other sponsors.

Fill out an RBA Scholarship Application.

Sponsors and Supporters

The RBA operates with the financial support of the local businesses listed below. For more information about sponsoring the RBA, please call 218-576-6174.

League Sponsors ($1,000+)

  • Brady VanHove Memorial Scholarship
  • Ally Financial
  • Harbor Pointe Credit Union
  • Pachel Foundation
  • Montgomery Sports Foundation
  • United Way

Team Sponsors ($999 & under )

  • Tender Loving Care Duluth
  • True North Orthodontics
  • Minnesota Power Employee Credit Union
  • A.W. Kuettel & Sons
  • Duluth Dodge
  • The Ski Hut
  • Kiwanis
  • Gianna Kneepkens

Additional support for the RBA is provided by local basketball standouts who practice with the kids, including players from the University of Minnesota-Duluth Bulldogs men's and women's teams.
